column1: # Book 6 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings, no secondaries. 6.753-754: non iras Palladis acris pervigili causa, the crows do not flee Pallas's anger at their watching (the Erichthonius story), recast so "not from Pallas's fierce anger / at their watchfulness" reads as the Latin runs. 6.762-764 recast as the Latin orders it (the gateway of Orcus, then the spirits led to Acheron, then the gods of the shades). 6.794 mulier sopita recumbit, the woman is the subject. 6.830-832 "at times" (inter dum) moved to the result clause to bring 6.830 into the band; the heads of the sentence stand. ratio at 6.861 and 6.866 = principle.
